title: tc-map-itinerary
description:
A trip planned day by day – the days as tabs, each day's stops in order with times and travel, and the stops on a
map drawn from their coordinates, the chosen day's route standing out.

heading.description: The heading, and the map's name

days.description: The days, in order, each with its stops in order

day.description: The chosen day's id; by default the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-day-change listener calls preventDefault()

stop.description: The picked stop's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-stop-select listener calls preventDefault()

fit.description: What the map fits: the chosen "day", or "all" days

kinds.description: Kinds' names and icons, merged over the defaults (sight, food, stay, transport, venue, other)

tileUrl.description: A map tile URL template with {z}, {x} and {y} (and optionally {s}); nothing loads until "Show map tiles"

tileAttribution.description: The tiles' credit, shown on the map once they load, e.g. "© OpenStreetMap contributors"

tileNote.description: Says where the tiles load from beside Show map tiles; by default the template's host

locale.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

time.description: When, in the trip's own words: "10:00", "Afternoon"

kind.description: A key of `kinds`: sight, food, stay, transport, venue, other – or the page's own

duration.description: How long to stay, in words: "1 h 30 min"

travel.description: Getting here from the stop before, in words: "12 min walk"

note.description: One quiet line, e.g. "Booked under the institute's name"
